snippet.title: Static Dread: The Submarine - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Static Dread: The Submarine is available now on Steam. Watch the Static Dread: The Submarine launch trailer for this psychological horror game. In Static Dread: The Submarine, descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.
